name: grimmsnarl_ml_v19
policy: v18 invariants over a newly trained high-rated, matchup-conditioned core ranker

training.refreshed_source: 600 newer trajectories from three pilots rated 1113.7-1151.0

teacher_selection.default: Sixth Sense: 62-57 over the generic public route
teacher_selection.mirror: Sixth Sense: 35-14, strongest of the refreshed panel
teacher_selection.wall: Sixth Sense: 7-3, with v18's deterministic wall guard retained
teacher_selection.alakazam: kd: 21-4, strongest of the refreshed panel
teacher_selection.information_boundary: active, bench, discard, pre-evolutions and stadium only; no hidden hand or deck
teacher_selection.score_invariant: one teacher code scores the complete candidate set of each argmax

policy_escalation.reason: the refreshed matchup teacher is already selected by the core model; the legacy v6 escalation would reintroduce a stale pilot

router.role: public-information selector for the learned teacher pin
router.switch_scope: categorical teacher code only; shared weights and one-code-per-argmax invariant remain fixed

files_changed_from_v18.main.py: wire the public route into the conditioned core
files_changed_from_v18.ml_runtime.py: use the model-embedded route teacher codes and retire the stale v6 escalation
files_changed_from_v18.ranker_model.json: new 454-tree fit from refreshed high-rated teachers
files_changed_from_v18.metadata.json: v19 data, fit, routing and comparison evidence

validation_scope.claim_limit: offline held-out imitation and local engine results can establish a stronger model candidate, not a guaranteed future rating

description: First post-v8 core-model refresh to clear a paired chronological held-out comparison against the deployed v8 ranker.
